text: diamonds, playing for a chance to live free and breathe easy and have enough money to take care of the folk they love. This is why we can't wait. That swirling Mississippi wind, the Alabama pine, that Tennessee dust, defiling the clothes the women washed, those hot winds the lemonade couldn't cool, that let the women know we too must overcome. This is for Fannie Lou Hamer, Joanne Robinson, Septima Clark, Daisy Bates, all the women who said, baby, baby, baby, I know you didn't mean to lose your job.
